The Frustration Emotion Task for Children (FETCH)

description.value: A frustration induction task in which children competed with Sparky to fetch bones, with win and frustration trials.

spans.text: Trials were grouped into three win and two frustration blocks
Win trials

description.value: Win trials in which the child touched the bone before Sparky, received animated positive feedback showing the child grabbing and placing the bone in a box, and progressed toward the most desired blue-box reward.

spans.text: Win trials were indicated by an animated drawing depicting the child grabbing the bone and placing it within one of five boxes indicating progression towards the most desired reward
frustration trials

description.value: Frustration trials in which Sparky took the bone before the child's possible reaction time, followed by animated negative feedback showing Sparky removing a previously earned bone and increasing distance from the desired blue-box reward.

spans.text: Frustration trials showed Sparky grabbing the bone and then taking a bone out of the previously won box

instructions.value: Children rated their preferred and least preferred prize boxes and were told that performance in the game would determine which box supplied their final prize. They then competed with Sparky, a sneaky dog, to fetch bones by touching them on the screen.

spans.text: Children were told that how well they did in the game would determine from which box they would choose their final prize at the end

stimuli.value: Three prize boxes (blue with exciting toys, red with small stickers, and yellow with a broken crayon), animated bones, Sparky the dog fetching bones, feedback animations showing bones earned or removed, sound effects, and seven cartoon faces for emotion ratings.

spans.text: The task was animated and contained engaging sound effects

value: Touch-screen bone-fetching responses and win/frustration trial outcomes; post-block emotion ratings on a seven-face scale.

spans.text: After each block, children completed an online emotion rating by choosing from seven cartoon faces ranging from negative to positive to indicate their current mood state
